scripts.build: npm run build -w @rollerskate/protocol && npm run build -w @rollerskate/local && npm run build -w @rollerskate/server
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --workspaces && npm run test:examples
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && (cd packages/protocol && node --experimental-test-coverage --test dist/test/*.test.js) && (cd local && node --experimental-test-coverage --test --test-concurrency=4 dist/test/*.test.js) && (cd server && node --experimental-test-coverage --test dist/test/*.test.js)
